CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

2. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

4. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.

5. Best practice when working on Weaving: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Weaving.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Weaving.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Weaving.
   D. Practise Weaving with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

7. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

8. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   B. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   C. Practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

9. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

10. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   C. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.

11. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   D. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   C. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.

13. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

14. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

15. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The suggest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain String Musical Instruments and Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Collage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Volleyball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and Pattern Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Weaving and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Gymnastics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
